user.title: Portainer Maintenance
user.description: One-time setup. Enter the URL where the Portainer actions webapp is reachable (e.g. https://actions.o.pumapants.cc), and pick the mobile_app device(s) that should get the "update performed" confirmation push. This integration registers it as a sidebar panel, installs its automation blueprint, registers the perform_update/update_done services, computes the notification click-through URL automatically, and exposes the update/trouble/stale tracking sensors.

data_description.admin_only: Hide the sidebar panel from non-administrator users. This only hides the panel inside Home Assistant; it does not control who can open the webapp's own URL.
data_description.sidecar_anonymous: Turn on only if the sidecar runs with AUTH_ALLOW_ANONYMOUS=true. Leave it off and the next screen asks for the username and password you gave the sidecar as AUTH_USERNAME and AUTH_PASSWORD, so the sidebar panel can sign in by itself.

sidecar_login.title: Portainer Maintenance: sidecar sign-in
sidecar_login.description: Enter the username and password the sidecar webapp is configured with (AUTH_USERNAME and AUTH_PASSWORD in its compose file). The sidebar panel uses them to sign in without asking.

data_description.sidecar_username: The same value as the sidecar's AUTH_USERNAME.
data_description.sidecar_password: The same value as the sidecar's AUTH_PASSWORD. Stored in this integration's config entry and used to build a sign-in token for the sidebar panel's URL.
